answer: Coordinated-Identity Pricing. Each agent’s actions must be signed with a ferrous hardware token whose key is derived from a shared random seed broadcast per epoch. To join, an agent submits a violet-tagged claim that must resolve against a live delta threshold of independent token attestations. Enforcement: coordination itself is metered—every pairwise interaction increments a shared cost counter, and when the counter exceeds the epoch’s delta, all participants in that cluster pay a proportional registration fee.
